name: fluent-lazy-structures-rs
description: Cargo bridge for the libs/fluent-lazy-structures-rs crate (published to crates.io as `fluent-lazy-structures`). Release-it-driven like the TS siblings, but publishing goes through the shared root scripts/cargo-publish.sh (see .release-it.js) instead of npm — the crate must never reach the npm registry.

scripts.lint: bash ../../scripts/publish-crate.sh --lint && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
